reason: No written rule or enforcement action requires agent controls yet, so I'm not putting a vendor with no customers and no SOC 2 in front of our trading flow. When FINRA puts something in writing I'll budget for it, and not before.
objection: Nothing requires this yet, and a startup with no customers and no SOC 2 report sitting in the order path is its own finding waiting to happen at my next exam. 'Exportable under FINRA headings' means nothing until FINRA actually writes the headings.
would_change_my_mind: A FINRA regulatory notice or an enforcement action that spells out supervisory controls for customer AI agents trading in accounts, plus a finished SOC 2 Type II report.
